From scanning to measurable impact in four simple steps.

Scan Food & Medicines

2

Track Expiry & PAO

3

Get Smart Reminders

Receive reminders before products expire or reach their PAO.

4

Reduce Waste

Use products in time, dispose responsibly and reduce unnecessary waste.

Why Reducing Everyday Product Waste Matters

Every year, food, medicines and personal care products go unused or are discarded. Better tracking can help households use products in time, reduce unnecessary waste and make more informed disposal decisions.

💧

Water

Food waste wastes valuable water resources.

🌍

Environment

Reducing waste helps reduce emissions.

💰

Unused and expired products can increase household costs.

FAQ

Quick answers about NoFoodMedWaste.

Is NoFoodMedWaste free?

Yes. Core features are available free of charge.

Does it work for medicines?

Yes. You can track medicine expiry dates and receive reminders.

Does NoFoodMedWaste track cosmetics?

Yes. You can organize cosmetics, track minimum durability dates and manage Period After Opening (PAO) information.

What is PAO?

PAO (Period After Opening) indicates the recommended period of use after a cosmetic product has been opened.

What is Smart Scan?

Smart Scan uses AI to identify products, barcodes and expiry dates.

Is the Android app available?

Currently available through Closed Testing.

Will there be an iPhone version?

iOS support is planned and coming soon.
